unsupported: invoice credit (D.S. 21531 art. 8 c) 1, plus the 20 % extra for Bolivian-made goods of D.S. 5503 from December 2025) needs boInvoices; taken as 0
balance in favour at the year end carries to the next year (not refunded); UFV maintenance of value ignored
interest: art. 19 c) excludes term deposits over 30 days (national currency) and others; not taxed
selfEmployment: RC-IVA 13 % on gross fees (art. 19 g); IVA and IT on the fees and the invoice credit not modelled
rent: RC-IVA 13 % on gross rent (art. 19 a), quarterly filing; IVA/IT not modelled
SIP: ANS thresholds as printed in 2019 (updates not checked)
